tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch3:3-9Suppose $G$ is a compact Lie group with a left-invariant metric $g$ and a left-invariant orientation. Show that the Riemannian volume form $dV_g$ is bi-invariant. [Hint: Show that $dV_g$ is equal to the Riemannian volume form for a bi-invariant metric.] \end{exercise}
